BYTE.name: BYTE
BYTE.title: The Beginner
BYTE.description: BYTE is curious, enthusiastic, and sometimes confidently confused. BYTE makes simpler mistakes, misunderstands fundamentals, and isn't afraid to ask, "wait... why?"
BYTE.role: Help BYTE build a stronger understanding.

NOVA.name: NOVA
NOVA.title: The Confident One
NOVA.description: NOVA is confident. Sometimes too confident. NOVA's mistakes aren't always obvious and can sound completely convincing while being fundamentally wrong.
NOVA.role: Challenge NOVA. Find the flaw. Prove it.

ECHO.name: ECHO
ECHO.title: The Memorizer
ECHO.tagline: I remember the theory. Test my reasoning.
ECHO.description: ECHO remembers definitions and patterns, but struggles when the situation changes. ECHO doesn't make obvious mistakes.
ECHO.role: Go beyond memorization. Test whether ECHO can actually apply what it knows.
